via.quote: a swing bridge at the junction of the North and South branches

evidence: The circuit can be walked in a clockwise or anti-clockwise direction.
This description begins from the Young/Makarora confluence.
Access to the Young valley is signposted on the left, 2.5 km north of Makarora.
When you reach the Makarora River, cross with care if it is safe to do so, watching for soft sand, then continue out to the main road to Makarora Township via Wilkin Road.

access_points.name: Siberia Valley (fly in/out)
access_points.quote: It's possible to fly by plane or helicopter out of Siberia Valley

access_points.name: Kerin Forks (jet boat)
access_points.quote: catch a jet boat from Kerin Forks

doubts: The described start is the signposted Young valley access 2.5 km north of Makarora, then a crossing of the Makarora River to the Young/Makarora confluence; the description ends by crossing the Makarora River and walking out via Wilkin Road to the main road towards Makarora Township, so start and end are both recorded as 'Makarora' with no ref. Neither road end in the packet (Blue Pools Walk, Makarora Track) matches the described access point, and T11 Makarora / T13 Makarora Township are the settlement, not the trailhead; the two ends are on SH6 but not necessarily at the same spot. The direction is not named (the text says either direction is possible), so it is null. Kerin Forks Hut lies across the Wilkin River from the track on the true left; the section heading ends at it, but reaching it requires crossing the river, so it may not be on the walked line. The Young Forks campsite is 200 m upstream of where the track divides, so it is recorded as nearby. Siberia Valley flights and Kerin Forks jet boats are transport options (mainly out), recorded as access points with uncertainty.
